term: Microsoft Foundry Hub vs. Foundry Project
definition: A **Foundry Hub** governs shared enterprise security, VNet/Private Link isolation, compute, and shared resource connections. A **Foundry Project** is a child workspace where teams build, evaluate, and deploy agents, workflows, and prompt flows.
examTip: Create shared connections (Azure AI Search, external models) in the Project so multiple client apps and agents reuse them without duplicating credentials.

term: Deployment Types: Global Standard vs. Data Zone vs. Provisioned vs. Batch
definition:
• **Global Standard**: Pay-as-you-go; routes inference globally.
• **Data Zone Standard**: Pay-as-you-go; keeps inference strictly within a geographic data zone (e.g., EU or US).
• **Data Zone / Global Provisioned (PTU)**: Reserved throughput for high-volume workloads needing predictable low latency variance.
• **Data Zone / Global Batch**: Asynchronous 24-hour processing of `.jsonl` files (linked via `custom_id`) at 50% lower cost.
examTip: EU high-volume shopping agent → Data Zone Provisioned; EU nightly catalog job → Data Zone Batch.

term: Model Router & Model Cascade
definition:
• **Model Router Deployment**: Routes requests across a custom subset of approved models (e.g., `gpt-4.1-mini` and `gpt-4.1`) with automatic failover.
• **Model Cascade**: Routes simple FAQs to a fast, low-cost SLM and escalates complex reasoning queries to a larger LLM.
examTip: Use a custom subset in the Model Router to block unapproved catalog models while preserving failover.

term: Model Version Policy & OpenAI v1 Targeting
definition: Setting version policy to **Upgrade once the new default version becomes available** automatically updates deployments like `Deployment1` (`gpt-4o`). Applications using the OpenAI v1 API target it via **`model="Deployment1"`**.
examTip: Pair `Global Standard` with `Upgrade once the new default version becomes available` and `model="Deployment1"`.

term: Catalog Model Selection: Codestral-2501 vs. Phi-4-multimodal-instruct
definition:
• **Codestral-2501**: Specialized code generation model accepting text inputs up to **250,000+ tokens** without tool calling.
• **Phi-4-multimodal-instruct**: Accepts **text, image, and audio** inputs and generates text summaries.
examTip: 250K-token bug-fix pipeline → `Codestral-2501`; text+image+audio field report summarization → `Phi-4-multimodal-instruct`.

term: Azure OpenAI Responses API & Deterministic Effort
definition:
• **Responses API**: `openai_client.responses.create(model=..., input=...)` via `DefaultAzureCredential()`.
• **Output Stability**: Set **`temperature=0`** to eliminate wording drift in validation pipelines, and set **`output_config={"effort": "high"}`** with `thinking={"type": "enabled"}` to maximize reasoning quality.
examTip: Never increase `temperature` to improve completeness; use `temperature=0` for consistent outputs.

deck: Set 2: Foundry Agent Service, Tools & Memory
term: Built-in Agent Tools: Code Interpreter vs. File Search vs. Bing vs. Computer Use
definition:
• **Code Interpreter**: Executes Python code for calculations, analyzing uploaded Excel/CSV spreadsheets, and generating charts.
• **File Search**: Searches documents (contracts/PDFs) uploaded directly during a conversation.
• **Grounding with Bing Search**: Fetches live public web information (weather, news, court decisions).
• **Computer Use**: GUI/browser automation to interact with legacy web portals that do not expose APIs.
examTip: Uploaded spreadsheets/charts = Code Interpreter; legacy portal without APIs = Computer Use; uploaded contracts = File Search.

deck: Set 2: Foundry Agent Service, Tools & Memory
term: Agent Memory vs. Threads vs. Ephemeral Session Context
definition:
• **Persistent Agent Memory**: Retains user preferences (airline, hotel, attorney preferences) across conversations, isolated per authenticated user.
• **Threads (`thread_id` / `conversation_id`)**: Preserves full multi-session case history including messages, uploaded log files, tool calls, and tool outputs.
• **Orchestration-Managed Session Context**: Ephemeral state discarded when the conversation ends (used for payment card details).
examTip: Reuse `thread_id` to resume multi-week support cases without manually reconstructing history.

deck: Set 2: Foundry Agent Service, Tools & Memory
term: Deterministic Tool Invocation (`tool_choice`)
definition:
• `"auto"`: Model decides whether to invoke tools.
• `"required"`: Forces the agent to call a tool on every run.
• `{"type": "mcp"}`: Deterministically forces invocation of a Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool.
examTip: If an agent responds without calling required tools, set `"tool_choice": "required"` in `run_payload`.

deck: Set 2: Foundry Agent Service, Tools & Memory
term: OpenAPI 3.0 Tools, Connections & Multi-Tenant Inputs
definition:
• Define an **API key security scheme** in the OpenAPI 3.0 spec and **connect the tool to the Project Connection (`Connection1`)** to avoid 401 errors.
• For multi-tenant agents requiring a runtime `customer_id`, add a **required structured input bound to the OpenAPI tool argument** and a **structured output JSON schema**.
examTip: Add custom functions or OpenAPI tools when agents must schedule meetings or call external APIs.

deck: Set 2: Foundry Agent Service, Tools & Memory
term: Structured Outputs (`json_schema`)
definition: Configuring **Structured Outputs with a JSON schema** guarantees that model responses strictly match required fields (e.g., `customer`, `product`, `location`, `topics`) and eliminates narrative prose or unexpected fields.
examTip: Always prefer Structured Outputs with a JSON schema over temperature tuning when downstream JSON parsers fail.

deck: Set 2: Foundry Agent Service, Tools & Memory
term: Parallel Tool Execution & Retry Backoff
definition:
• **Parallel Tool Calls**: Execute independent tool calls in parallel in application logic to reduce total response latency.
• **Exponential Backoff and Jitter**: Mitigates intermittent HTTP 429 rate-limit exceeded errors during load spikes.
examTip: Do not create new threads or retry immediately on HTTP 429; always use exponential backoff + jitter.

term: Foundry Workflows vs. Group Chat vs. Custom Code
definition: A **Foundry Workflow** orchestrates multiple specialized agents (`TriageAgent`, `PolicyAgent`, `ActionAgent`) using a deterministic, step-based process with conditional branching and shared state while minimizing development effort.
examTip: Choose a **workflow** whenever deterministic step-based branching and shared state are required.

term: Microsoft Agent Framework Patterns: Concurrent vs. Handoff
definition:
• **Concurrent Orchestration**: Sends the same input (e.g., company profile for due diligence) to multiple agents simultaneously and collects their independent outputs.
• **Handoff Orchestration**: Lets a triage agent transfer conversation control to a single specialist agent based on context.
examTip: Use **Semantic Kernel** or **Microsoft Agent Framework** to orchestrate multi-agent workflows integrated with Azure resources.

term: YAML Workflow Human Approval (`ask_question`)
definition: In a Foundry YAML workflow, pause execution for human approval before a sensitive action (like `PaymentAgent` issuing a refund) by setting the approval step `type` to **`ask_question`** and the execution step `condition` to **`approval == "approved"`**.
examTip: `type: ask_question` + `condition: approval == "approved"`.

term: Power Fx Expressions in Workflows (`Local.Var01`)
definition:
• Validate that local variable `Var01` from an Ask a question node is non-empty: **`Not(IsBlank(Local.Var01))`**
• Output `Var01` in uppercase in a Send message node: **`{Upper(Local.Var01)}`**
examTip: Remember the `Local.` scope prefix and curly braces `{...}` for string interpolation in Send message.

term: Multi-Agent Staging Contract Tests
definition: When independently versioned agents in GitHub Actions fail handoffs due to incompatible message schemas, **add a deployment graph and staging contract tests for dependent agents** to block incompatible promotions to production.
examTip: Contract tests validate input/output schemas between dependent agents before production rollout.

deck: Set 4: Knowledge Grounding, RAG & Azure AI Search
term: Agentic RAG vs. Classic RAG
definition: **Agentic RAG** uses multi-turn conversation history to plan retrieval, breaks complex questions into sub-queries, retrieves information across multiple chunks, and runs retrievals in parallel to reduce latency.
examTip: Multi-turn retrieval planning + parallel multi-chunk queries = **Agentic RAG**.

deck: Set 4: Knowledge Grounding, RAG & Azure AI Search
term: Foundry IQ Knowledge Base & Remote SharePoint Source
definition: For HR agents grounded in frequently updated SharePoint libraries with Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels and M365 Copilot licenses, use a **Remote SharePoint knowledge source** in Foundry IQ to return live content while preserving user-level ACL permissions without index maintenance.
examTip: Pair **Foundry Agent Service memory** (user context) with **Foundry IQ knowledge bases** (governed docs).

deck: Set 4: Knowledge Grounding, RAG & Azure AI Search
term: Advanced Data Parsing for Scanned Multipage Tables
definition: **Advanced data parsing** re-ingests scanned PDFs with OCR, preserves multipage tables and headings as structure-aware chunks, and stores page-number metadata with each chunk.
examTip: Plain-text or single-page chunking loses multipage table row context.

deck: Set 4: Knowledge Grounding, RAG & Azure AI Search
term: RAG Retrieval Tuning: Chunk Count (`top_k`) & `strictness`
definition:
• **Omitted clauses from lengthy legal docs**: Increase the number of retrieved document chunks.
• **Doubled prompt size & high cost with unchanged quality**: Retrieve fewer document chunks.
• **Prioritize only the most relevant documents**: Set **`strictness`** to a higher value.
examTip: To include source citations (`title`, `url`), query Azure AI Search for chunks + metadata fields and inject both into the prompt.

deck: Set 4: Knowledge Grounding, RAG & Azure AI Search
term: Indexing Embedded PDF Images (`generateNormalizedImages` & OCR Skill)
definition: Configure the Azure AI Search indexer with **`imageAction: generateNormalizedImages`** to populate `/document/normalized_images/*`, add the built-in **OCR skill** targeting `/document/normalized_images/*`, and map `text` and `layoutText` outputs.
examTip: The `index` property in the Foundry Search tool must be set to the **Azure AI Search index name**.

deck: Set 4: Knowledge Grounding, RAG & Azure AI Search
term: AI Enrichment: Entity Linking Skill & Knowledge Store
definition:
• **`Microsoft.Skills.Text.V3.EntityLinkingSkill`**: Enriches indexed text with links to Wikipedia articles.
• **Knowledge Store**: Data structure in Azure Storage that stores enriched and indexed skillset output for downstream apps.
examTip: Wikipedia links = `EntityLinkingSkill`; storing enriched output for downstream apps = `knowledge store`.

term: Content Understanding Built-in Analyzers (`prebuilt-*`)
definition:
• **`prebuilt-read`**: Extracts all readable text via OCR at lowest cost without layout, tables, or LLM deployment.
• **`prebuilt-layout`**: Preserves PDF layout, sections, tables, and detects **QR codes** without requiring an LLM deployment.
• **`prebuilt-documentFieldSchema`**: Extracts structured fields (e.g., employee ID, full name, expiration date) into a structured schema.
• **Custom Analyzer**: Extracts custom fields (invoice/PO number, vendor, total) across varying templates and returns **confidence scores** for routing (<0.80).
examTip: Enable **`estimateFieldSourceAndConfidence`** to get per-field confidence scores and source bounding-box locations.

term: Content Understanding Task Modes: Standard vs. Pro
definition:
• **Single-file task in Standard mode**: Cost-effective, high-volume processing of standalone PDF invoices, individual audit reports, or single video files.
• **Multi-file task in Pro mode**: Cross-document validation and multi-step reasoning across multiple related reports or reference data.
examTip: Standalone single file (PDF or video) = **Single-file task in Standard mode**; multi-document reasoning = **Multi-file task in Pro mode**.

term: Document Intelligence Markdown Output (`ContentFormat.MARKDOWN`)
definition: Setting **`output_content_format=ContentFormat.MARKDOWN`** in Azure Document Intelligence extracts scanned engineering drawings and vendor invoices into structured Markdown preserving tables, headings, paragraphs, and reading order for LLM summarization.
examTip: Minimizes custom post-processing before passing document content to an LLM.

term: Document Intelligence Models: General, Prebuilt & Custom Classification
definition:
• **General document model (`prebuilt-document`)**: Extracts key-value pairs, selection marks, and tables in Document Intelligence Studio.
• **Prebuilt Models**: `Health Insurance Card`, `ID Document`, and `Invoice` (`prebuilt-invoice`).
• **Custom Classification Model**: Classifies incoming documents into predefined categories before field extraction.
examTip: The Layout model can extract tables from JPEG/PNG/TIFF photos without training via **SDK**, **REST API**, or **Document Intelligence Studio**.

term: Azure Speech: Real-Time vs. Batch vs. Custom Speech
definition:
• **Real-time Speech-to-Text**: Processes streaming telephony audio with transcripts appearing within seconds; paired with **Text-to-Speech** for low-latency conversational turn-taking.
• **Custom Speech**: Trains on audio samples + reference transcripts in Speech Studio to recognize proprietary product codes and regional accents. Uses the **custom speech project ID**.
• **Model Expiration**: When a custom speech model expires, requests **fall back to the most recent base model for the same locale**.
examTip: Expired custom speech models do NOT fail with 4xx errors—they fall back to the base locale model.

term: Azure Speech MCP Server Configuration
definition:
• **Tool authentication**: `Foundry resource key`
• **Minimum Blob SAS permissions**: `Container read/write; file read`
• **Synthesizing speech from an agent**: Call the **Responses API with an `agent_reference` to `Agent1`** and ask `Agent1` to synthesize `reply_text`.
examTip: Speech MCP Server needs container read/write to write output files and file read to read input audio blobs.

term: Voice Live API Session Configuration
definition:
For a Python client streaming microphone input and playing audio responses locally in multilingual conversations, configure:
• **Session modalities**: `Text and audio`
• **Audio handling**: `Multilingual VAD and echo cancellation`
examTip: Echo cancellation prevents local speaker playback from triggering false voice activity detection.

term: Azure Translator: Mixed-Language Calls & Batch Document Translation
definition:
• **Mixed-language live call segments (English + Spanish)**: **Split the mixed-language segments into single-language segments** and translate each separately.
• **Hundreds of Word/PowerPoint manuals in Blob Storage**: Use **Azure Translator asynchronous batch document translation** to preserve layout and write directly to a target container.
examTip: Batch document translation preserves `.docx` and `.pptx` formatting automatically.

term: Azure Language: PII Detection & Custom QnA Synonyms
definition:
• **PII Detection**: Use category **`Person`** to flag staff member names.
• **Custom Question Answering API**: Remove special characters (such as `#` in `"#diagnostic"`) from synonym `alterations` so the API call succeeds.
examTip: Special characters like `#` and `&` cause validation errors in Custom QnA and Video Indexer language training.

deck: Set 7: Vision, Video Indexer & Generative Media
term: Generative Image Editing: `mask_inpainting` vs. `image_variation` vs. `input_fidelity`
definition:
• **`mask_inpainting`**: Supplies the input image + mask to edit *exclusively* inside the masked region (removing a competitor logo, removing a parked vehicle, or replacing a sky with a sunset).
• **`image_variation`**: Generates stylistic alternatives from an original product image while preserving composition and subject.
• **`input_fidelity="high"` / Reference Image**: Maintains product identity (e.g., a jacket photo) across new backgrounds and scenes.
examTip: Mask-based regional edit = `mask_inpainting`; whole-image stylistic alternatives = `image_variation`.

deck: Set 7: Vision, Video Indexer & Generative Media
term: Conversational Image Agent & DALL-E REST Properties
definition:
• **Conversational Banner Agent**: Use **`gpt-4o` (`model-01`)** for the agent definition deployment and **`gpt-image-1` (`model-02`)** for the image generation tool deployment.
• **DALL-E 3 REST API**: Include **`prompt`** in the HTTP request body and read generated image URLs from the **`result`** element.
examTip: Do not use embedding models (`text-embedding-3-large`) as agent or image tool deployments.

deck: Set 7: Vision, Video Indexer & Generative Media
term: Sora 2 Video Generation, Reference Media & Remixing
definition:
• **Python SDK Polling**: Create job with **`client.videos.create(model="sora-2", prompt=prompt)`** and poll with **`client.videos.retrieve(video.id)`**.
• **8-Second Landscape Teaser with Reference Image**: `model="Deployment1", size="1280x720", seconds=8, input_reference=Image1.png`.
• **Preserve Structure & Change Color**: Set **`remix_video_id`** to `video_123`.
examTip: `remix_video_id` preserves camera motion, framing, and timing of an existing video.

deck: Set 7: Vision, Video Indexer & Generative Media
term: Azure Vision: Spatial Analysis, OCR & Image Analysis API
definition:
• **Spatial Analysis**: Detects the presence and movement of people in live video feeds.
• **OCR**: Extracts handwritten and printed text from scanned images.
• **`imageanalysis:analyze?features=read,description`**: Returns visible text in the image and a natural-language description of the image content.
examTip: People detection in live video streams = **Spatial Analysis**.

deck: Set 7: Vision, Video Indexer & Generative Media
term: Azure AI Video Indexer: Training Rules & Multi-Language Detection
definition:
• **Multilingual videos**: Set `sourceLanguage` to **`multi-language detection`**.
• **Custom Language model training practices**: (1) Include multiple examples of spoken sentences, (2) Provide multiple adaptation options, (3) Put only one sentence per line, and (4) **Remove `&` characters** so sentences aren't discarded.
examTip: Memorize the 3 training practices and removing `&` from `"Azure & the cloud"`.

deck: Set 7: Vision, Video Indexer & Generative Media
term: Accessibility Metadata for Charts (`isDecorative: false`)
definition:
For a bar chart supporting report text (`North America: $4.2M, Europe: $3.1M, Asia-Pacific: $2.4M`), output:
• `"altText": "Bar chart showing Q3 revenue by region."`
• `"isDecorative": false`
• `"extendedDescription": "North America revenue is $4.2 million, Europe revenue is $3.1 million, and Asia-Pacific revenue is $2.4 million."`
examTip: Data charts are never decorative (`isDecorative: false`).

deck: Set 8: Content Safety, Prompt Shields & Guardrails
term: Prompt Shields (User Prompts vs. Documents) & Spotlighting
definition:
• **Prompt Shields for User Prompts**: Detects direct jailbreak attempts entered by users.
• **Prompt Shields for Documents**: Detects indirect prompt injection hidden in uploaded documents, external web pages, or OCR text extracted from uploaded screenshots.
• **Spotlighting**: Marks third-party content as lower trust.
• **Block vs. Annotate**: Use **Block** to stop attacks immediately; use **Annotate** when security admins want to review detections before deciding to block.
examTip: Image moderation alone does NOT stop text-based prompt injections hidden inside images—use **Prompt Shields for Documents**.

deck: Set 8: Content Safety, Prompt Shields & Guardrails
term: Image Moderation & Custom Output Severity Filters
definition:
• **Image Moderation**: Classifies user-uploaded photos for harmful visual content and blocks based on severity.
• **Custom Image Generation Filter**: To apply policy *only after image generation*, allow Safe/Low Violence, and allow only Safe Hate, configure **`Filter stage: Output filters`** with Blocked severities **`Violence: Medium and High; Hate: Low, Medium, and High`**.
examTip: To protect all stages of an agent run, select **User input, Output, Tool response, and Tool call** and set Action to **Block**.

deck: Set 8: Content Safety, Prompt Shields & Guardrails
term: Input Manipulation vs. Response Verification Controls
definition:
• **Input manipulation control** (blocking attempts to override system instructions in user inputs and retrieved articles): **`Prompt Shields`**
• **Response verification control** (identifying ungrounded responses before they reach customers): **`Groundedness detection`**
examTip: Reject responses that do not meet the groundedness threshold and return a fallback response.

deck: Set 8: Content Safety, Prompt Shields & Guardrails
term: Responsible AI Supported Agent Scenarios
definition:
Approved Microsoft Foundry Agent scenarios include:
1. Categorizing municipal service requests and compiling status updates.
2. Collating hospital SOPs and shift policies into nurse orientations.
3. Recommending retail gift options based on stated customer needs and past purchases.
examTip: Agents must align with Responsible AI principles—transparent, assistive, and human-governed.

term: Least-Privilege Azure RBAC Roles Cheat Sheet
definition:
• **Azure OpenAI Model Inference (fixes HTTP 403 after `az login`)**: `Cognitive Services OpenAI User`
• **Read-only Blob Storage access (RAG agents & Content Safety image URLs)**: `Storage Blob Data Reader` with a **System-assigned managed identity**
• **Querying an Azure AI Search Index (fixes HTTP 403)**: `Search Index Data Reader`
examTip: Never use Storage Account Keys, SAS tokens, or `Owner`/`Contributor` when a Managed Identity + Reader role satisfies the requirement.

term: Network Security: Private Endpoints vs. VNet Service Endpoints
definition:
• **Restrict Azure OpenAI resource to apps in your subscription only**: Set network security to **`Disabled, and allow a private endpoint connection to establish access`**.
• **Allow an Azure VM to access Custom Vision / AI Services with firewall enabled via service endpoint**: **`Grant access to a specific virtual network`**.
examTip: Private Endpoint disables public network access completely; Service Endpoint grants access to a specific VNet.

term: Centralized SIEM Security Operations (`Microsoft Sentinel`)
definition: To detect suspicious sign-in activity, investigate security incidents, and correlate alerts across **Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Entra ID**, deploy **Microsoft Sentinel** backed by a **Log Analytics workspace**.
examTip: Application Insights and OpenTelemetry are for application performance tracing, whereas Sentinel + Log Analytics is for SIEM security correlation.

term: Centralized Credential Management in Foundry Projects
definition: To allow multiple client apps or multiple agents in `Project1` to share the same Azure AI Search resource or external Foundry Model deployment without key-based auth or duplicate settings, **create a Connection in `Project1` and reference the connection** across apps/agents.
examTip: Project Connections centralize Entra ID / keyless authentication and endpoint configuration.

term: Observability Signals Matrix
definition:
• **Tracing / Latency Breakdown Traces / Tool Execution Traces**: Ordered sequence of LLM calls, tool invocations, intermediate steps, and stage timing.
• **Token Usage / Completion Token Analytics**: Diagnoses cost spikes caused by larger prompts, longer responses, or expanded tool usage.
• **Groundedness Evaluation Metrics**: Detects claims unsupported by retrieved RAG documents.
• **Relevance Evaluation**: Detects answers that fail to address the user's question despite relevant retrieved docs.
examTip: External Python services use **OpenTelemetry** + **Application Insights** for end-to-end tracing.

term: Telemetry Privacy (`enable_content_recording=False`)
definition:
• `configure_azure_monitor(connection_string=...)` records prompt/completion content unless explicitly disabled.
• `AzureAIOpenTelemetryTracer(..., enable_content_recording=False)` **prevents sensitive user prompts and model responses from being logged** to Application Insights.
• Multiple services (Foundry Agent Service and LangChain) can share a **single Application Insights resource** and be distinguished via telemetry attributes.
examTip: Covers all 3 Yes/No statements in Q10 (`No`, `Yes`, `No`).

term: Diagnostic Logging & 429 Capacity Diagnostics
definition:
• **Diagnostic Logging Prerequisites**: Requires a **Log Analytics workspace** and/or an **Azure Storage account**.
• **Diagnosing 429 Errors & 'No relevant information found'**: Enable **`Model Availability Rate and Provisioned Utilization`** metrics and collect **`RequestResponse`** diagnostic logs.
• **RAG Pipeline Dashboard**: Track **`Validation failure rate over time`** (ingestion quality) and **`Retrieval evaluation score on a labeled query set`** (relevance).
examTip: `RequestResponse` logs + `Model Availability Rate and Provisioned Utilization` pinpoint capacity vs. availability failures.

term: GitHub Actions CI/CD: OIDC & Evaluation Quality Gates
definition:
• **Passwordless Auth**: Authenticate using the **Azure Login action with OpenID Connect (OIDC)** and **workload identity federation**.
• **PR & Production Quality Gates**: Run **Groundedness evaluation**, **compare against the latest approved baseline**, **require the evaluation workflow to succeed before merging**, and **fail the workflow** if regression exceeds tolerance.
• **Post-Release Monitoring**: Use **Scheduled Foundry evaluations with Azure Monitor alert rules** to detect regressions after catalog updates.
examTip: Never use long-lived PATs or storage keys in GitHub Actions—always use OIDC + workload identity federation.
